algorithm: stable descending truncation; uniformly sample parents from ceil(0.1*P) valid current-generation candidates; two unmodified elites; independent additive Gaussian mutations std=0.15 with per-gene probability 0.2; clip to [-5,5]
topology: fixed dense immediate input-hidden/hidden-output; delayed hidden-hidden including self loops; no structural mutation
bias: evolved hidden bias; output bias zero; responses one
rng: JAX root semantic evolution namespace; complete key in WeightState; independent of evaluator chunking
invalid: nonfinite score excluded from parents/elites; valid elites repeated if too few; all-invalid abort
fitness: same evaluator as CPPN; maximize mean return or balanced memory accuracy
selection: top-eight final training candidates; select on separate validation; held-out never selects
quality: report every baseline score; failing the task learning target does not invalidate the baseline or permit tuning against these seeds
comparison: fixed evaluation budget plus wall-time-to-that-budget; no fixed-wall-time quality claim without a separately executed time-budget protocol
reuse: same algorithm and parameters at M2/M3/M5; task-specific input/output and hidden size match the fixed substrate
